fey-pact.summary: A bargain with the Feywild: Sylvan, nature lore, fey cantrips and a silver tongue.

Fey Bond.summary: Learn Sylvan (another language of your choice if you know it) and gain Nature proficiency.

Fey Cantrips.summary: Know Druidcraft plus one Divination or Enchantment cantrip of your choice, cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat).

Honeyed Words.summary: Reroll a failed CHA (Deception or Persuasion) check and keep the new roll. Once it turns a failure into a success, it's gone until a Long Rest.

infernal-pact.summary: A bargain with the Nine Hells: fire or poison resistance, sight through magical darkness and a liar's tongue.

Infernal Resistance.summary: Resistance to Fire or Poison damage, your pick.

Infernal Sight.summary: Darkvision out to 30 ft that magical Darkness doesn't block.

fey-sentinel.summary: Deeper fey magic: vanish when attacks miss, blink across the field and call up grasping plants.

Fading Target.summary: Reaction when an enemy's attack roll misses you: turn Invisible until your next turn starts, or until right after you attack, deal damage or cast a spell. Once per Long Rest.

Fey Shift.summary: On a Dash, swap the extra movement for a teleport to an unoccupied space you see up to half your Speed away.

Nature’s Roots.summary: Entangle is always prepared (Plant Growth too from level 5), each castable once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. The ability you raised casts them.

infernal-bulwark.summary: Devilish defenses: scaled skin, fiery Armor of Agathys and fire that punishes those whose effects you resist.

Devil’s Flesh.summary: Without armor or a Shield, your base AC is 10 + DEX + the ability you raised.

Infernal Protection.summary: Armor of Agathys is always prepared, cast with CHA. Once per Long Rest cast it without a slot as a level 2 spell dealing Fire instead of Cold; you can also cast it with your slots.

Vengeful Surge.summary: Reaction when you pass a save forced by a creature you see within 60 ft: it takes 1d10 Fire. PB uses per Long Rest.

infernal-dragoon.summary: A warrior of the Hells: a frightening aura, a patron's nudge on a roll and a long-lasting Magic Weapon.

Devilish Aura.summary: Magic action: creatures you choose in a 30-ft Emanation make a CHA save (DC 8 + PB + the ability you raised) or are Frightened until their next turn ends. A creature that saves is immune for 24 hours.

Devil’s Favor.summary: Add +2 to a D20 Test. Once per Long Rest.

Diabolic Empowerment.summary: Magic Weapon is always prepared, cast with CHA; once per Long Rest without a slot, and that casting lasts 8 hours. You can also cast it with your slots.
